About

About Quila

Quila Baratti is a cosmetology student at Sierra Academy of Style in Carson City. She does the full range of cosmetology: acrylic and gel sets, hand-painted and 3D nail art, spa manicures and pedicures, hair styling, color, facials, waxing and tinting. All services are performed under the supervision of a licensed instructor.

Many of her clients are regulars, and she loves trying new designs, from homecoming and graduation sets to everyday looks.

Good to know

  • Book online right on this page, or send Quila a DM on Instagram.
  • "And up" prices depend on hair length and amount of product used
  • All haircuts include shampoo and a quick dry
  • Packages can't be combined with any other discounts
  • Services depend on student availability
  • The academy is rated 4.8 on Google from 275 reviews
